title: LawyerOne 对接配置
description: 连接成功后，即可使用案例检索、法规检索、法律咨询、裁判预测、合同生成、合同审查、单方文书生成与文件脱敏八大法律服务。Token 仅存储在本机`~/.workbuddy`。
description_en: Connect your Fabao account to unlock 8 legal AI services: case search, regulation search, legal consultation, judgment prediction, contract generation, contract review, document generation and desensitization. API Key is stored locally only, never uploaded to cloud.
